reviews.title: Continually get messages to leave a review
reviews.text: I pay for a subscription and I have had the app for many years. I am tired of the pop-up to review the ad. I hope I stop getting the pop-up now.

reviews.title: Be careful
reviews.text: If you have Apple Pay, be careful, there's a button you can accidentally press and it automatically signs you up for a one year paid for subscription... they also won't redeem you your money for the error.

reviews.title: Lazy legacy modifications
reviews.text:
App was a blessing and after a few years of being on the premium platform. I enjoyed unlocking the new workouts, but (humbly) I made advanced adjustments to the rest and work seconds of each workout in the set. Subsequently the program freezes the calorie counter after twenty minutes or so, causing the workout to be inaccurate based on calories burned.

I sent a bug report to the staff and there’s no response or explanation for the errors causing the workouts to be fruitless.

Also they have a competition league for people to compete with in the app but its based on the number of workouts you did in order to advance and people CHEAT in order to get ahead on the *podium*

For those who are looking to push themselves with their health and exercise endurance be aware it will work but there is a ceiling to seven. They rarely add new movements to the app.

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: The overall concept is good, but I used it for almost six months, and was on a diet and saw little to no progress. Although the rewards made it fun, it still seemed ineffective. Also, the subscription is expensive for what you’re getting from it.

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Okay for an app. Only one week free. Not worth paying for.
